featured.title: Speculative Self-Distillation enables Efficient Knowledge Internalization
featured.tldr: Speculative Self-Distillation lets the student write rollouts and hands control to the teacher only where the two strongly disagree, matching on-policy accuracy with 38 to 69% fewer supervised tokens.

featured.title: On the Generalization Limitation of On-Policy Distillation for Post-RL Consolidation
featured.tldr: Merging several specialist models into one with on-policy distillation reaches near-teacher scores on training tasks yet loses ground on harder or combined tasks, unless supervision is also broadened.

featured.title: SpecOPD: Branch-Parallel On-Policy Distillation for Speculative Decoding
featured.tldr: SpecOPD trains speculative-decoding draft models on their own sampled outputs in parallel branches, lifting accepted-token length by up to 41% and training throughput 16x.

featured.title: Weaken to Strengthen: Weakening-Induced On-Policy Self-Distillation for Large Reasoning Models
featured.tldr: WISD improves reasoning models with no labels or stronger teacher by training them toward tokens the original model prefers over a deliberately quantized or pruned copy of itself, adding 4 to 5.5 points on average.

featured.title: Tree-Aware Posterior Distillation for Long-Horizon Agentic Reinforcement Learning
featured.tldr: TreeOPSD branches rollouts from shared prefixes to give each agent turn credit without a critic, then trains toward a bounded target, improving deep-research accuracy of Qwen3 agents by up to 4.97 points over GRPO.

featured.title: ActionOPD: Distilling Decisions, Not Tokens
featured.tldr: ActionOPD distills a black-box teacher agent into a small student by rewarding agreement on the decision, not the tokens, lifting four out-of-domain tool-use benchmarks by 3.3 to 6.9 points.

featured.title: LLM-to-Flow Distillation: Teaching Natural Language Goals to Scientific Generators
featured.tldr: LLM-to-Flow Distillation lets a frozen LLM steer a peptide or molecule generator toward a natural-language goal using preference judgments, beating reward-guided baselines without any proxy reward.

featured.title: Simplifying and Improving On-Policy Distillation for Few-Step Diffusion
featured.tldr: Simplified Matching Distillation compresses image, video and audio-video generators to a few sampling steps with plain on-policy velocity regression and no adversarial training, sometimes beating the multi-step teacher.

featured.title: Self-Retrospection Distillation: Turning Post-hoc Experiences into Prior Foresight
featured.tldr: Self-Retrospection Distillation trains an agent to anticipate its own likely pitfalls using hindsight from completed rollouts, recovering learning signal where outcome rewards vanish and lifting results across ten benchmarks.

featured.title: The Teacher Is a Direction, Not a Destination: Extrapolating RL-Induced Representation Residuals in On-Policy Distillation
featured.tldr: RIDE distills an RL-trained teacher into its base model by extrapolating hidden states past the teacher along the direction RL moved them, matching or slightly beating the teacher on competition math.
